value_stream.name: Customer Digital Engagement & Mobile App Operations

fields.Participants: Store Ops IT, Marketing, Merchandising, Digital Product Manager
fields.Trigger: Kiosk content refresh or system update

Automation Opportunity: - Process steps auto-sequenced with system controls; data-entry auto-populated from master data; exceptions auto-flagged for human review
Controls: - CTL-455 (ensure controlled execution — In-Store Digital Experience & Self-Service (PA-75.2).)
- operational: Store Operations IT sign-off on the workflow output
Pain Points / Risks: - **Execution risk**: process variability or system failure disrupts the workflow's output; mitigated by the documented procedure and the system controls

- **Data-quality risk**: incomplete or inaccurate master data (pricing, inventory, customer) corrupts the workflow output; mitigated by the master-data governance (VS-29 / W291) and the periodic audit
Time Estimate: - Absorbed into the Store Operations IT role; not incremental headcount unless volume scales significantly.

steps.activity: Store Ops IT manages kiosk fleet: monitors uptime (99%), remote content management, OS updates, hardware maintenance; replaces faulty units within 48 hours
Marketing updates content: promotional videos, product spotlights, store map, loyalty info, DIY videos, seasonal campaigns; refreshes monthly with weekly promo updates
Digital Product Manager analyzes usage: interaction count, most-viewed content, session duration, conversion to sale; optimizes content placement

steps.activity: Merchandising generates shelf-edge QR codes: links to product page with specs, reviews, how-to videos, related products, stock availability
Customer scans QR with phone camera: opens mobile-responsive page with details, price, availability, ratings, installation guides, accessories
Product Manager tracks analytics: scan volume by category, conversion (scan → purchase), popular products; identifies enhanced content opportunities

steps.activity: Customer uses self-checkout: scans items, places on weighted verification platform, pays via card/GCash/Maya (no cash); system verifies weight matches expected
LP Officer monitors: reviews exception alerts (weight mismatch, barcode override), assists customers, responds to intervention alerts; staff available for age-restricted authorization
VP Store Operations evaluates: throughput vs. staffed checkout, satisfaction, shrinkage rate, maintenance cost; determines expansion, modification, or discontinuation

Customer uses in-store features: scans products for details, creates shopping list with aisle locations, requests price check; Store Manager receives traffic heat map
Product Manager analyzes: activation rate, feature usage frequency, correlation with basket size; optimizes features; reports to CMO and VP Store Operations

steps.activity: POS generates digital receipt: transaction details, loyalty points earned, warranty info; pushes to app and/or email per customer preference; replaces paper for opt-in customers
Customer accesses history in app: full purchase history, digital receipts, warranty tracking, return eligibility, re-order for consumables, tax summary for BIR
Finance tracks digital receipt adoption: target >50% within 2 years (saves ~PHP 10M/year paper costs); monitors delivery success rate; reports paper saved for ESG

workflows.name: Digital Price Tag & Electronic Shelf Label Management

Automation Opportunity: - Pricing auto-computed from the cost + margin target; settlement auto-reconciled with discrepancy-flagging; invoice auto-generated from the POD/delivery record
Controls: - CTL-455 (ensure controlled execution — In-Store Digital Experience & Self-Service (PA-75.2).)
- CTL-455 (price-change authorization — links to VS-08 / W40); Operational: Merchandising Operations sign-off on the workflow output
Pain Points / Risks: - **Margin-erosion risk**: pricing miscalculation (commission, discount, surcharge) erodes net margin below target; mitigated by the margin-floor guard and pre-launch validation

- **Data-quality risk**: incomplete or inaccurate master data (pricing, inventory, customer) corrupts the workflow output; mitigated by the master-data governance (VS-29 / W291) and the periodic audit
System Touchpoints: - Ecommerce/marketplace platform (links to VS-10 / W11 BOPIS, W180 marketplace integration)
- Pricing/financials (links to VS-17 / W9 financial close, VS-29 / W289 pricing master)
Time Estimate: - Absorbed into the Merchandising Operations role; not incremental headcount unless volume scales significantly.

steps.activity: Pricing Manager triggers change in ERP: pushes to ESL system via store network; ESLs update within 5 minutes; supports dynamic and time-based promotional pricing
Store Ops verifies daily: spot-checks 20–30 ESLs vs. POS price; reports sync failures; ESL system alerts for low-battery labels
Merch Ops tracks performance: price sync accuracy (99.9%), battery life management, hardware failure rate; ROI: eliminates ~18M paper labels/year
